title: AlphaLogics: A Market Logic-Driven Multi-Agent System for Scalable and Interpretable Alpha Factor Generation
central_strategy: Eight LLM-agent roles reverse-extract market logic from Alpha101/191/158/360, compile each logic into constraints over a 59-operation factor DSL, generate and optimize factor expressions with backtest feedback, refine the market-logic library over five outer rounds, and synthesize selected factors through an unspecified LightGBM/Qlib Top-50/drop-5 trading stack.

current_release_check.arxiv_id_code_results: unaffiliated QuantNodes/component implementations and paper digests only

required_but_missing: The initial and evolved market-logic libraries and the deterministic H-to-structured-H-to-Gamma compilation mapping.
Filled LLM requests/responses, model revisions/settings, selection objective J, budgets, and seeds.
The generated factor formulas, trial trajectories, accepted pool, signs, and LightGBM configuration/weights.
Frozen data/universe snapshots, Qlib handler, predictions, holdings, returns, and execution settings.
A resolved Top-50/drop-5 portfolio definition consistent with the claimed source implementation.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_base_libraries_are_not_alphalogics: Alpha101, Alpha191, Alpha158, and Alpha360 are seed/baseline libraries from which logic is mined. Evaluating one directly would omit the paper's defining logic generation, constraint compilation, factor evolution, and final pool.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_independent_code_is_not_a_strategy: QuantNodes passes component tests but substitutes IR for IC, runs four rather than five outer rounds, omits Alpha191/360 at initialization, and contains no paper-generated factors or result lineage.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_does_not_resolve_the_gap: JKP supplies suitable OHLCV-style monthly inputs only after a factor formula exists; it cannot infer the unreleased market logic, compiler output, evolved formulas, selection objective, or fitted model.

closure_rule: Do not promote seed libraries, an independent implementation, thematic market-logic prose, or generic JKP technical factors to AlphaLogics. Reopen for an author-attributable final factor pool or executable generation/model release.
